title: HUB2 · HanzMeteo
description: Nová měření z BLE přijímače HUB2.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "meteo")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "meteo" and r.device == "HUB" and r._field == "temp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
